gate_upgrade_legacy_explanation.en-US: This legacy backup contains an account root that may have been copied, so the former address cannot safely resume. Komms will decrypt it only into an unpublished migration projection, then publish a fresh account containing cleared petnames and accurately labelled local pairwise/note history. Groups, routes, sessions, devices, queues, and service capabilities will not transfer. Every retained contact must be re-verified.

Komms afkóðar það aðeins í óbirta flutningsmynd og birtir síðan nýjan reikning með hreinsuðum gælunöfnum og nákvæmlega merktri staðbundinni sögu einkasamtala og minnispunkta. Hópar, leiðir, lotur, tæki, biðraðir og þjónustuheimildir flytjast ekki. Staðfesta þarf alla varðveitta tengiliði aftur.

gate_upgrade_migration_explanation.en-US: Komms found no linked-device root copy in this store. Keep this address only if you also never exported or copied a legacy KKR7 backup. If you did, choose the conservative new-identity reset below. In-place migration keeps this device, petnames, and history after you save the root as a separate offline authority.

Every retained contact must be re-verified.
